The '''Industrial Sector''' was a region of the [[Darkside (sector)|Darkside]] district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The area contained a lot of industrial machinery and specialized in re-forming scrap materials from Darkside's [[Recycling Sector]] and the upper levels of Coruscant, to turn them into usable building materials. Circa [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] traveled to Darkside and hid [[Garth Ezzar's Sith Infiltrator|his starship]], a [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] [[Star Courier/Legends|Star Courier]], inside a building located on the corner of the Industrial Sector.
